name: Basketball
overview: Scripture encourages believers to commit their efforts to the Lord, ensuring their thoughts and actions are established in Him rather than seeking personal glory (Proverbs 16:3; 25:27). The strength and endurance needed in activities like basketball are renewed by waiting upon the Lord, who empowers His people to run without weariness (Isaiah 40:31). Joyful play among children is a picture of God’s blessing and peace in the community (Zechariah 8:5), while the pursuit of honor should be directed toward God alone, recognizing that with Him nothing is impossible (Luke 1:37; John 5:44).
